prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2.5D fantasy game prop sprite atlas.
The reference image is the approved B03 gameplay environment preview: use ONLY its cheerful sunny hand-painted rendering, cream/mint/lavender/pumpkin materials, 3/4 near-isometric camera and village object designs. Do NOT reproduce HUD, floor, characters, screenshot composition, sky or backdrop.
Generate ONE genuinely transparent RGBA PNG, approximately 2500 x 2000, an INVISIBLE UNIFORM GRID OF EXACTLY 5 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, with exactly 20 separate standalone complete objects, one object per cell, in the following precise row-major order. Each cell has the same dimensions. Objects are centered in their own cells with at least 12% clear transparent margin on all four sides, including roofs, sails, foliage and small soft cast shadows. Never allow any pixel of an object or shadow to reach a neighboring cell. No drawn grid, no cell borders, no text, no labels, no letters or numerals anywhere.
All assets must be isolated cutout game sprites on REAL alpha transparency, not a painted checkerboard, not a white/black/parchment background, not decorative scenery tiles. The entire unused area and all outer corners must be fully transparent. No ground plane, no stone-paving patches, no terrain rectangles, no large platform under the object. A tiny structural foundation/steps belonging to a building is acceptable. A compact contact shadow can have partial alpha.

Rendering: bright polished hand-painted cartoon fantasy, strong readable 2.5D forms, high three-quarter near-isometric game view, consistent camera and warm sunlight from upper-left. Clean medium illustrated outlines, delicate material detail, cream stone, mint green plaster and brass accents, lavender tiled roofs and patchwork fabric, pumpkin orange, small white flowers and fresh leaves. This is a whimsical undead CIVILIZATION with happy everyday town objects, no scary cemetery. Asset silhouettes must remain legible at small in-game scale. Show front and right sides consistently; top surfaces visible. Buildings full intact designed silhouettes, not huge stretched floor-texture walls. No active enemies or player characters.

Exact 20 objects:
Row 1, cell 1: lavender_cottage — a compact mint-plaster sleeping cottage with lilac tiled roof, rounded cream door, tiny pumpkin doorknob, orange patchwork curtains and small hat-shaped chimney.
Row 1, cell 2: coffin_postoffice — a complete whimsically yawning coffin-shaped post office building, tall rounded coffin facade, top hat, lavender roof, envelope mail slot and mint/cream structure. The yawning face is charming architecture, no gore.
Row 1, cell 3: sweet_warehouse — a rounded orange pumpkin candy shop/warehouse with stem chimney, translucent candy-paper windows full of star candies, a lavender/mint striped short awning and small cream steps.
Row 1, cell 4: chime_pavilion — a beautiful small three-petal lilac hat-roof bell pavilion, four slim cream columns with mint brass trim, one little gold bell, light ribbons; bottom entirely open.
Row 1, cell 5: candle_bakery — a compact paired oven shop, one orange smiling pumpkin oven and one lilac top-hat candle oven, cream walls, lavender awning, tiny flower-candle display. No industrial machinery.

Row 2, cell 1: tailor_shop — a complete small open top-hat-shaped tailor shop with lilac patchwork roof, large decorative round-headed scissors sign, mint door and colorful spool awning; no lettering.
Row 2, cell 2: moon_sail_ferry — a whimsical large mint wooden ferry with top-hat cabin, cream crescent-moon sail, pumpkin lantern chain, brass rails and mint/lavender patches. Entire hull and sail visible, no water patch beneath it.
Row 2, cell 3: mayor_hall — a complete modest fantasy town hall with cream plaster, mint door, lavender top-hat roof silhouette, a pumpkin badge and patchwork ribbons, no lettering.
Row 2, cell 4: coffin_postbox — a small lilac coffin-shaped mailbox wearing a crooked top hat, cream envelope slot and mint brass handle, on two short feet.
Row 2, cell 5: ghost_tea_stall — a small open wooden afternoon-tea stall under a lilac patchwork umbrella, mint teapot and pumpkin cups, one tiny friendly white ghost decorative tea server belonging to the stall, no separate NPC.

Row 3, cell 1: hat_headstone — one low rounded cream headstone with a lavender top hat, friendly carved face, mint flower accent and small white flowers at its foot. A single small object, no grave pit.
Row 3, cell 2: pumpkin_flowercart — a compact mint wooden wheeled pumpkin flowercart with orange pumpkin shell basket, white and lavender flowers, brass buckles and a small lilac fabric banner. Entire wheels and handles visible.
Row 3, cell 3: pumpkin_flowerbed — a low curved standalone cluster of orange pumpkins, mint leaves, cream daisies and lilac blossoms. Organic outline, no rectangular soil tile or tall wall.
Row 3, cell 4: chime_mast — a slim mint-brass wind-chime stand holding small top-hat bells, a crescent wood charm and colorful patchwork ribbons. Stable small foot, no electrical coil.
Row 3, cell 5: spool_table — a small mint-and-wood sewing table bearing colorful fabric-thread spools, rounded needle case and brass buttons; four small feet, no electrical wire or industrial winch.

Row 4, cell 1: dress_form — a padded cream doll dress form on a tiny mint stand, wearing a lilac top hat and cheerful patchwork orange/mint jacket. It is a mannequin, not a living enemy.
Row 4, cell 2: sweet_crate — a small open mint-brass wooden crate containing translucent candy-paper parcels of colorful star candies, clean friendly shape.
Row 4, cell 3: candy_vat — a small smiling orange pumpkin sugar kettle with mint handles, rounded brass legs and a tiny curl of pink candy steam; no industrial pipe tank.
Row 4, cell 4: ghost_boat — a small mint/orange pumpkin rowboat with a cream crescent sail, lilac top-hat lantern cabin and one tiny sleeping white ghost inside. Complete hull and oars, no water plane.
Row 4, cell 5: mint_bench — a low cream/mint park bench with rounded brass-capped arms, lilac patchwork seat pad and tiny orange pumpkin decoration, no ground slab.

Constraints: exactly 20 objects; order fixed; 5x4 equal invisible cells; true transparent background; no overlap between cells; no text or watermark; no UI; no wide terrain pieces; no gray/white/checkerboard fake backdrop; no blood, rotting corpses or skeleton piles; no industrial winches, power coils or rusted tools; no dark gloomy lighting; preserve complete roofs/sails/feet, no cropping.
